method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: JPMorgan Chase is the largest US bank, headquartered in New York. Strategy roles are in-house (corporate strategy, line-of-business strategy, internal consulting, chief-of-staff teams); entry-level hiring runs through analyst programs.
business_type: In-house strategy at a global bank

differentiators.text: The Corporate Analyst Development Program (summer internship leading to a two-year rotational full-time role) builds skills in analytics, project management or process improvement.
differentiators.significance: A structured, rotational entry into corporate roles, though it leans operational rather than strategic.

early_career.text: Two-year rotational analyst programs give new grads structured placements across corporate teams.
early_career.significance: Rotations help you find the right team without changing employer.

employee_support.text: Since 2023 JPMorgan gives 16 weeks of paid leave to either parent for birth or adoption, regardless of primary-caregiver status; postings also list back-up childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental-health support and on-site health centres.
employee_support.significance: Documented family and wellbeing support at large-bank scale.

flexibility.text: In January 2025 JPMorgan told hybrid employees to return to the office five days a week from March 2025, while saying it still supports 'flexibility in the workplace'.

unknowns: Hours in strategy teams versus banking teams.
